description: SPM DFES Breakdown by Licence is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " SPM DFES Breakdown by Licence " data table provides a detailed breakdown of peak demand and installed generation capacity by technology type at a licence level. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Future Networks. Its keywords are Forecast, Distribution, SPM, DFES, Low Carbon, Generation. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
